what: Same question asked three ways on 2026-10-11: a chat model through its API, the same model's web app, and Qloo's taste graph. This file backs the comparison on the Devpost page.
prompt: Recommend 8 cafés in Taipei that someone who loves Simple Kaffa (a specialty coffee roaster) would also like. For each, give the name and the district. Answer only as JSON: [{"name": "...", "district": "..."}]

chat_web_app.note: Gemini web app with Google Maps grounding, so not LLM-only

results.chat_api_places_that_exist: 8 of 8 (each found by a Qloo place search in Taipei)
results.chat_api_and_web_app_share: 7 of 8 (matched by hand: Rufous Coffee Roasters = RUFOUS COFFEE; only Mountain Kids Coffee Roaster is API-only and Single Origin espresso & roast is web-only)
results.qloo_places_in_neither_chat_answer: 6 of 8 (only RUFOUS COFFEE and Mountain Kids Coffee Roaster appear in a chat answer)

not_included: Qloo's response (place list, addresses, ratings) is not stored in this repository, as the README's Data and attribution section states. Run the app with a key to reproduce it.
